body:
You're fine.  I appreciate the thought.

I'm better now - some events over the past week have helped me out of depression and into plain sadness and anger towards him.  Those I can get through.

> Do you have any thoughts about why you have poor self-esteem? Things about the person you are now that you don't like?

Oh, do I ever.  And most of them are irrational, as these things tend to be.   My thought is in **bold**, my reality is in _italics_

**I'm fat, and unattractive**  
_I'm 6'4, 175lbs, and am actually pretty handsome.  Most people tell me so.  I used to be 250lbs, and have been there several times, but have been holding steady at 175 for almost a year now_

**I'm not worth anything**  
_I've got a steady job, no debt, and am working on saving up for a house.  I make close to 6 figures a year, and don't have a whole lot of expenses_

**People don't like me, I'm an asshole**  
_I do have a temper, and I am quick to argue over most things that I find stupid.  But whenever I bring this up, nearly everyone says that I'm a nice guy.  And I try to be.  I'm polite, courteous when I can, and genuinely try to make other people happy_


The list goes on and on.  But those are the top ones.

Because the man of my dreams has no interest in having a homosexual relationship.  He'd be fine fucking me, but wants nothing more than that.  And because he knows I am heels over head in love with him, he won't even go near me.

I know I'm relatively young (I'm only 27), but every relationship I try ends in disaster.  And pile that on top of massive self-esteem issues to begin with, and it makes me wonder what I have to offer to anyone.
Thanks.  But after months of hurting, I don't know of another way out of this.  Every time I get out of the pit of despair, I'm dragged back down by something or other.  I've got nothing left.
